verdict.rationale: Fellow documents a REST Developer API reached through 'standard REST calls', an OpenAPI 3.1 description, webhooks and an MCP server. Nothing in the evidence shows an official, Fellow-published SDK or client library in any language. The OpenAPI spec is only a building block a developer could use to generate a client, so it earns no credit, and an SDK is a fair question for a SaaS product with a developer API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
